Source.Name: osinfo-db
Source.Summary: Operating system database for virtualization provisioning tools
Source.Description: The osinfo-db package provides the operating system information database which contains information about operating systems, hypervisors and the virtual hardware devices they can support. This is used by virtualization provisioning tools such as virt-manager, virt-install and libosinfo to describe the virtual machines they manage.

Update.Comment: First release. Provides the OS information database used by virt-manager/virt-install and libosinfo.
